hero.title: Practical Travel Information
hero.subtitle: Essential guidance for travelers visiting Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania — visas, vaccinations, safety tips, currencies and more.

intro.title: Before You Travel
intro.text: Entry requirements, vaccination rules and travel advisories may change over time. Always confirm with official government sources before departure. The information below provides general guidance for East African travel.

items.0: Kenya: eVisa required for many travelers. East Africa Tourist Visa available.
items.1: Uganda: eVisa required for most visitors.
items.2: Tanzania: Visa on arrival available for many nationalities.
items.3: East Africa Tourist Visa covers Kenya, Uganda & Rwanda (single visa).
items.4: Passport validity: Minimum 6 months before expiry.

items.0: Yellow Fever certificate required when traveling between endemic countries.
items.1: Malaria prevention recommended for safari regions.
items.2: Routine vaccinations advised (Tetanus, Hepatitis A/B, Typhoid).

items.3: USD widely accepted for tourism (newer notes preferred).
items.4: Visa & Mastercard accepted in most hotels/lodges.

items.2: Follow park ranger instructions during safaris.
items.3: Keep copies of passports and insurance documents.

items.0: June–October: Dry season, ideal for wildlife viewing.
items.1: December–March: Good for safaris and beach holidays.
items.2: April–May: Rainy season in many regions.
Hotels and lodges usually provide WiFi.

items.0: Road travel between Kenya, Uganda & Tanzania possible.
items.3: Domestic flights common for safari routes.
Always have your embassy contacts available.

hero.title: Booking With Confidence
hero.subtitle: Every Luxe Plains booking is secured, itemised in full and backed by a team who has walked this ground long before you arrive. No hidden costs, no vague promises — just a clear path from enquiry to the savanna.

secure.title: Your booking, secured
secure.body: Payments run through encrypted, PCI-compliant checkout. Deposits are held in a protected client account, and every booking is processed under a licensed tour operator — never a third-party reseller.

transparent.title: Pricing you can actually read
transparent.body: Your quote shows the full cost before you pay a cent — no park-fee surprises, no fuel surcharges added later. Cancellation and refund terms are written in plain language, not buried in fine print.

unforgettable.title: Built for the experience, not the spreadsheet
unforgettable.body: Small groups, private vehicles, and guides who grew up reading this land. Every lodge and camp on your itinerary is named and vetted in person — never 'similar standard.'

process.title: How a Luxe Plains booking actually works
process.subtitle: Four steps, each one documented in writing before you move to the next.

step1.title: Enquire
step1.body: Tell us your dates, your budget and the trip you're picturing. A person on our team replies within 24 hours — not a chatbot.

step2.title: Customise
step2.body: We build, and rebuild, your itinerary until it's right, with every camp, transfer and activity priced line by line.

step3.title: Secure your dates
step3.body: Pay a protected deposit through encrypted checkout. You receive written confirmation and a full payment schedule immediately. [Deposit  50%]

step4.title: Travel, fully supported
step4.body: Settle the balance ahead of departure and travel with a 24/7 in-country contact, briefed on your trip before you land. [Balance due 30 days before departure]

faq1.q: What payment methods do you accept, and are they secure?
faq1.a: We accept major credit cards and bank transfer through an encrypted, PCI-compliant payment gateway. We never store your full card details on our servers.

faq2.q: How much deposit do I pay, and when is the balance due?
faq2.a: A deposit secures your dates at the time of booking, with the balance due ahead of departure. Exact amounts and deadlines are confirmed in writing before you pay anything.

faq3.q: What happens if I need to cancel?
faq3.a: Our cancellation terms are set out in full in your booking confirmation, including any refundable portions and applicable deadlines, so you know where you stand before you commit.

faq4.q: Is my money protected if something goes wrong?
faq4.a: Your deposit is held in a protected client account, and your booking is issued under a licensed tour operator, so your payment is never just sitting in a personal account.

faq5.q: Will the lodges and camps match what I was quoted?
faq5.a: Yes. Every camp named in your itinerary is the camp you stay in. If availability ever changes, we contact you directly with alternatives before making any substitution.

cta.title: Ready to start your enquiry?
cta.body: Tell us about the trip you're picturing — we'll reply within 24 hours with a clear, fully priced plan.

hero.title: Pay However Works Best for You
hero.subtitle: Choose M-Pesa for an instant deposit, a direct bank transfer for larger payments, or a card for fast, secure checkout from anywhere. Every method lands in the same protected account.

mpesa.title: Pay with M-Pesa
mpesa.body: Send your deposit or balance instantly through Lipa na M-Pesa — the quickest option if you're paying from Kenya or East Africa.
mpesa.step1: Open the M-Pesa menu on your phone
mpesa.step2: Select Lipa na M-Pesa, then Pay Bill
mpesa.step4: Enter your booking reference as the account number
mpesa.step5: Enter the amount, confirm with your PIN, and keep the SMS receipt

bank.title: Bank transfer to Stanbic Bank
bank.body: For larger payments or transfers from outside East Africa, pay directly into our Stanbic Bank account.
bank.note: We accept transfers in {currency}. Please use your booking reference as the payment reference and email the transfer confirmation to your safari consultant so we can match it to your booking.

card.title: Pay by card
card.body: Pay securely online through our encrypted checkout — the same protected gateway covered on our Booking With Confidence page.
card.note: Card payments are processed instantly. Your bank may apply its own foreign transaction or currency conversion fee — check with them if you're paying from outside Kenya.

mpesa.bestFor: Quick deposits from Kenya and East Africa

faq1.q: Which payment method should I use?
faq1.a: If you're in Kenya or East Africa, M-Pesa is usually fastest for deposits. For larger payments or transfers from Europe and further afield, bank transfer or card both work well — card clears instantly, while a bank transfer can take a few business days.

faq2.q: Will I be charged any transfer fees?
faq2.a: M-Pesa and card payments are processed without an extra fee from us. Bank transfers may incur a fee from your own bank — it's worth checking with them before you send larger amounts.

faq3.q: What currency should I pay in?
faq3.a: M-Pesa payments are made in Kenyan shillings. Bank transfers and card payments can be made in US dollars or Kenyan shillings — your quote will confirm the currency for your booking.

faq4.q: How do I confirm my payment has been received?
faq4.a: For M-Pesa and bank transfers, send your safari consultant the SMS confirmation or transfer receipt and we'll match it to your booking and confirm in writing. Card payments are confirmed automatically at checkout.

faq5.a: Yes. Card payments run through an encrypted, PCI-compliant gateway, and we never see or store your full card number — see our Booking With Confidence page for the full breakdown.

faq6.q: Can I split my payment between methods?
faq6.a: Yes — many guests pay their deposit by M-Pesa or card and settle the balance by bank transfer, or vice versa. Just let your safari consultant know so each payment is recorded against the right booking.

cta.title: Not sure which option fits your booking?
cta.body: Tell us where you're paying from and how much, and we'll point you to the simplest method.

comparison.title: Private Safari vs Shared Safari
comparison.description: Get a clear quote for your exact dates and group size from our team, or compare what a private versus shared safari experience generally looks like below.

rows.sharedSafari: Shared van or jeep with other groups

rows.privateSafari: Fully flexible — stay as long as you choose
Guide positions vehicle for optimal angle and light
Guide can follow animal movement in real time
rows.sharedSafari: Route is predetermined — may miss movements

rows.privateSafari: Door-to-door from your hotel or airport
Entirely determined by your group and what you see
Higher quality per hour, maximum sightings probability
rows.sharedSafari: Lower price, less control over experience
